text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Starting today, my trainee and I will be taking on the Twinkle Series. The Umamusume joining me for this journey is none other than…

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: I'm Eishin Flash. Pleased to be working with you.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: In order to ensure maximum efficiency over the next three years, let's carefully devise a perfect schedule in advance.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: I intend to train and race with all the effort I can muster to ensure this perfect schedule is conducted flawlessly. Your assistance will be much appreciated.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: And so, <chrname> and I take our first steps towards competing in the Twinkle Series!
